description: This file contains a mock implementation of an image service for testing purposes within the Kubernetes CRI API, including methods to set up fake images, retrieve image info, and simulate image operations.

classes.name: FakeImageService
classes.description: A mock implementation of the image service used for testing, with methods to manipulate and query fake images and filesystem usage.

methods.name: SetFakeImages
methods.description: Sets the list of fake images for the FakeImageService.

methods.name: SetFakeImagesWithAnnotations
methods.description: Sets the list of fake images with annotations for the FakeImageService.

methods.name: SetFakeImagePinned
methods.description: Sets the pinned status for a specific fake image.

methods.name: SetFakeFilesystemUsage
methods.description: Sets the fake filesystem usage data.

methods.name: SetFakeContainerFilesystemUsage
methods.description: Sets the fake container filesystem usage data.

methods.name: NewFakeImageService
methods.description: Creates a new instance of FakeImageService.

methods.name: makeFakeImage
methods.description: Creates a fake runtimeapi.Image object based on an ImageSpec.

methods.name: stringInSlice
methods.description: Checks if a string is present in a list of strings.

methods.name: InjectError
methods.description: Injects an error for a specific function to simulate failure.

methods.name: popError
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the first error for a specific function.

methods.name: ListImages
methods.description: Returns the list of images, possibly filtered.

methods.name: ImageStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a specific image.

methods.name: RemoveImage
methods.description: Removes an image from the fake service.

methods.name: ImageFsInfo
methods.description: Returns filesystem info related to images.

methods.name: AssertImagePulledWithAuth
methods.description: Asserts that an image was pulled with specific authentication.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Shuts down the fake image service.
